signatures.description: Implement an on-disk B+tree with a slotted-page layout: variable-length keys, slot-array compaction, prefix-compressed interior keys, and atomic page splits that enforce a minimum fill factor. Leaf merges after delete must avoid underflow while keeping sibling redistribution exact, and crash-recovery must be idempotent via a redo record. Prove byte-level page invariants hold across a randomized workload of insert/delete/scan against a sorted-map oracle.
